title: GEMMAPsycho
summary: A pipeline for fine-tuning Gemma language models to perform psychometric (Big Five) personality classification from text. Its synthetic-data module builds SingleTableMetadata and fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate training examples, then validates them with sdmetrics' DiagnosticReport and QualityReport.
